qe: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the constitution of Legislatures in States?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद राज्यों में विधानमंडलों के गठन का प्रावधान करता है?
o: Article 168
Article 172
Article 171
Article 170
e: Article 168 ke anusaar pratyek rajya ke liye ek vidhan mandal (Legislature) hoga, jismein ek ya do sadan ho sakte hain - yani kuchh rajyaon mein keval vidhan sabha (unicameral) hoti hai aur kuchh mein vidhan sabha ke saath vidhan parishad (bicameral) bhi. Article 170 vidhan sabha ke sadasyon ki sankhya ke bare mein hai, Article 171 vidhan parishad ke gathan ke bare mein, aur Article 172 vidhan mandal ke kaaryakal (tenure) ke bare mein; isliye 'vidhan mandal ka gathan' wala pravdhan Article 168 hi hai. Article 168 ke teht hi Union Territories ke liye bhi sansad kanoon banakar legislature bana sakti hai (jaise Delhi aur Puducherry ke liye hua). Exam point: Article 168 = rajyaon ke vidhan mandalon ka gathan (ek ya do sadan); 170 = vidhan sabha ki sadasyata, 171 = vidhan parishad.

qe: How many States in India currently possess a bicameral legislature with both a Legislative Assembly and a Legislative Council?
qh: वर्तमान में भारत के कितने राज्यों में द्विसदनीय विधानमंडल (विधानसभा और विधान परिषद) है?
o: 5 States
7 States
6 States
8 States
e: Is samay Bharat mein 6 rajyaon mein dvigrihi (bicameral - do sadan wali) vyavastha hai: Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh aur Telangana. In sabhi rajyaon mein vidhan sabha (Lower House) ke saath vidhan parishad (Upper House/Legislative Council) bhi hoti hai. Pehle 7 rajyaon ki suchi mein Jammu aur Kashmir bhi tha, lekin 2019 mein J&K ko rajya se sangha kshetra (UT) banane aur uske vidhan parishad ke samapt hone ke baad ye ginti 6 reh gayi. Vidhan parishad banane ya khatm karne ka adhikar Article 169 ke teht hai, isliye koi bhi rajya apni marzi se ise badal sakta hai. Exam point: bicameral legislature wale 6 rajya = UP, Bihar, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana (pehle J&K bhi tha).

qe: Under Article 170 of the Constitution, what is the maximum permissible numerical strength of a State Legislative Assembly?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 170 के अनुसार राज्य विधानसभा की अधिकतम अनुमेय सदस्य संख्या क्या है?
o: 500 members
550 members
403 members
450 members
e: Article 170 ke anusaar rajya vidhan sabha ke sadasyon ki adhiktam (maximum) sankhya 500 aur nyoontam (minimum) 60 ho sakti hai - is sankhya ka aadhar jansankhya hota hai, aur seema-nirdharan (delimitation) ke baad ye tay hoti hai. Kuchh chhote rajyaon ke liye samvidhanik apvaad hain - jaise Sikkim mein 32, Mizoram mein 40, Goa mein 40 aur Puducherry (sangha kshetra) mein 30 sadasya ho sakte hain. 550 Lok Sabha ki adhiktam sankhya hai, isliye rajya vidhan sabha ke liye 550 wala aankda galat hai; 403 to Bihar ki vidhan sabha ka purana aankda hai (aaj 243). Exam point: vidhan sabha = 60 se 500 sadasyon ki seema (Article 170), chhote rajyaon ke liye apvaad.

qe: What is the minimum constitutional age requirement to become a Member of the Legislative Council (MLC) in a State?
qh: किसी राज्य में विधान परिषद का सदस्य (MLC) बनने के लिए न्यूनतम आयु क्या निर्धारित है?
o: 35 years
25 years
30 years
21 years
e: Vidhan Parishad (MLC) ka sadasya banne ke liye nyoontam aayu 30 saal honi chahiye - yahi shart Article 173 ke saath padhi jaati hai (aur Article 171 ke pravdhanon se juri hai); vidhan sabha (MLA) ke liye ye aayu 25 saal aur Lok Sabha ke liye bhi 25 saal hi hoti hai. 35 saal ki shart rashtrapati/uparashtrapati ke chunav aur Rajya Sabha ke sadasya (30+) ke liye alag-alag hai; 21 saal panchayat ya nagar nikay ke chunav ki nyoontam aayu hai. Isliye vidhan parishad ke liye sahi aankda 30 saal hai. Exam point: MLC ki nyoontam aayu = 30 saal (MLA/LS = 25 saal, Rajya Sabha bhi 30 saal, panchayat = 21 saal).

qe: Who holds the final, non-justiciable authority to certify whether a legislative bill in a State is a 'Money Bill' under Article 199?
qh: राज्य विधानमंडल में कोई विधेयक 'धन विधेयक' है या नहीं, इसे प्रमाणित करने का अंतिम अधिकार किसके पास है?
o: The Governor of the State
The Chief Minister
The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
The Chairman of the Legislative Council
e: Article 199 ke anusaar ye sawaal ki koi vidheyak (bill) rajya ka 'dhan vidheyak' (Money Bill) hai ya nahi, ispar antim (final) nirnay vidhan sabha ke Adhyaksh (Speaker) ka hota hai - aur uska ye nirnay sansad ke Speaker ke nirnay ki tarah antim maana jaata hai, jispar adalat vyavharik roop se sawaal nahi utha sakti. Rajyapal, mukhya mantri ya vidhan parishad ke adhyaksh is nirnay mein koi bhoomika nahi nibhate. Dhan vidheyak ka pravdhan isliye ahem hai ki wo keval vidhan sabha mein pesh hota hai (Article 207) aur vidhan parishad us par sanshodhan nahi kar sakti - keval 14 din tak rakha sakti hai. Exam point: rajya ka Money Bill hai ya nahi - antim nirnay vidhan sabha ke Speaker ka (Article 199), ye non-justiciable hai.

qe: Under Article 169 of the Constitution, which institution is empowered to abolish or create a State Legislative Council?
qh: संविधान के अनुच्छेद 169 के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद का सृजन या उत्सादन करने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: The Governor through an executive ordinance
The State Legislative Assembly acting alone
Parliament by Law, following a special majority resolution by the State Legislative Assembly
The President of India on Cabinet advice
e: Article 169 ke anusaar rajya mein vidhan parishad (Legislative Council) banane ya khatm karne ka adhikar Parliament ke paas hai, lekin ye keval tab jab sambandhit rajya ki vidhan sabha ek 'vishesh bahumat' (special majority) wala prastav paas kare ki aisi parishad banayi jaaye ya khatm ki jaaye - uske baad Parliament kanoon banaati hai. Ismein khaas baat yahi hai ki prastav vidhan sabha ka hota hai (vidhan parishad ka nahi), aur kanoon Parliament ka; isliye rajya apni marzi se parishad khatm nahi kar sakta, kendra ki vidhi chahiye. Rajyapal ke aadesh, vidhan sabha ke akele faisle, ya rashtrapati ke aadesh se ye kaam nahi hota. Exam point: vidhan parishad banane/khatm karne ki prakriya = vidhan sabha ka vishesh bahumat prastav + Parliament ka kanoon (Article 169).

qe: Under Article 171, the total membership of a State Legislative Council cannot exceed what proportion of the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171 के तहत विधान परिषद के सदस्यों की कुल संख्या विधानसभा की कुल सदस्य संख्या के कितने भाग से अधिक नहीं हो सकती?
o: One-third (1/3rd)
One-fifth (1/5th)
One-half (1/2)
One-fourth (1/4th)
e: Article 171 ke anusaar kisi rajya ki vidhan parishad (Legislative Council) ke sadasyon ki sankhya vidhan sabha ki kul sadasyata ke ek-tihai (1/3) se adhik nahi ho sakti, aur nyoontam (minimum) sankhya 40 honi chahiye - yani parishad kabhi bhi vidhan sabha se badi nahi ho sakti. Ye seema isliye rakhi gayi hai ki prathinidhi sadan (vidhan sabha) ki praadhanikta bani rahe, aur parishad keval samiksha (review) karne wala sadan rahe. Iske alava parishad ke gathan ke paanch bhaag hote hain - 1/3 sthaniya sansthaon dwara, 1/3 MLA dwara, 1/12 graduate, 1/12 adhyapak aur 1/6 Rajyapal dwara naamit. Isliye '1/2', '1/4' ya '1/5' wale aankde samvidhan ke aadhaar se hat kar hain. Exam point: vidhan parishad = vidhan sabha ki adhiktam 1/3 sadasyata, nyoontam 40 (Article 171); Bihar mein 75 sadasya.

qe: Under Article 189(3), what is the statutory quorum required to constitute a valid meeting of a State Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 189(3) के अनुसार राज्य विधानसभा की बैठक के लिए आवश्यक वैधानिक कोरम क्या है?
o: Strictly 15 members
One-twentieth of the total membership
10 members or one-tenth (1/10th) of the total members of the House, whichever is greater
One-fifth of the total membership
e: Article 189(3) ke anusaar rajya vidhan sabha ki baithak ke liye quorum (ganpoorak sankhya) 10 sadasya ya sadan ki kul sadasyata ka ek-dasvaan (1/10) hissa - jo bhi zyada ho - hona chahiye; itni sankhya maujood na hone par adhyaksh baithak ko sthagit (adjourn) kar sakte hain ya baithak nahi chalti. Ye niyam sansad ke quorum ki tarah hai, jahan bhi kul sadasyata ka 1/10 hissa chahiye (Lok Sabha mein ~55 aur Rajya Sabha mein 25). 15 sadasya wala koi samvidhanik aankda nahi hai, aur '1/5' bhi galat hai. Isliye sahi jod 10 ya 1/10 (jo zyada ho) hai. Exam point: vidhan sabha ka quorum = 10 sadasya ya kul sadasyata ka 1/10, jo zyada ho (Article 189(3)).

qe: Who elects the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the State Legislative Assembly under Article 178?
qh: अनुच्छेद 178 के तहत राज्य विधानसभा के अध्यक्ष और उपाध्यक्ष का चुनाव कौन करता है?
o: The members of the Legislative Assembly from amongst themselves
Joint sitting of both Houses of the State Legislature
The Governor of the State
The Chief Minister and Council of Ministers
e: Article 178 ke anusaar rajya vidhan sabha ke sadasya apne hi beech se Adhyaksh (Speaker) aur Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Speaker) ka chunav karte hain - isi tarah vidhan parishad ke sadasya apne beech se Adhyaksh (Chairman) aur Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Chairman) chunte hain. Ye pad chunav ke baad adhyaksh sadan ke kaam-kaaj aur niyamon ko chalate hain; Rajyapal, mukhya mantri ya mantri-parishad in padon ke liye kisi ko niyukt nahi karte, aur sanmilit baithak (joint sitting) state legislature mein hoti nahi hai (joint sitting keval sansad mein hoti hai). Speakar ka chunav karte samay sansad ke up-mahasachiv jaise adhikari adhyaksh kar sakte hain, par faisla sadasyaon ka hi hota hai. Exam point: vidhan sabha ke Speaker aur Deputy Speaker = sadasyaon dwara apne beech se chune jaate hain (Article 178).

qe: What is the maximum duration for which a State Legislative Council can delay a Money Bill passed by the Assembly?
qh: राज्य विधान परिषद विधानसभा द्वारा पारित धन विधेयक को अधिकतम कितने समय तक रोक सकती है?
o: 30 days
6 months
14 days
3 months
e: Rajya vidhan parishad dhan vidheyak (Money Bill) ko adhiktam 14 din tak hi rok sakti hai - Article 198 ke anusaar ye 14 din ki samay-seema hai; agar 14 din mein parishad koi faisla na de to vidheyak us roop mein paas maana jaata hai jis roop mein vidhan sabha ne bheja tha. Iske alava parishad is vidheyak mein sanshodhan bhi nahi kar sakti - wo keval sifarish (recommendation) de sakti hai, jise maanna vidhan sabha ke liye zaroori nahi. Yahi vyavastha sansad mein Rajya Sabha ke liye Article 109 ke teht hai (wahan bhi 14 din). Isliye '30 din', '3 mahine' ya '6 mahine' wale vikalp galat hain - dhan vidheyak par rajya ki upper house ka samay 14 din hi hai. Exam point: Money Bill par vidhan parishad ki seema = 14 din (Article 198), koi sanshodhan adhikar nahi.

qe: What is the constitutional duration and renewal cycle of a State Legislative Council under Article 172(2)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 172(2) के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद का कार्यकाल और नवीनीकरण चक्र क्या है?
o: It is a permanent body not subject to dissolution, with one-third of its members retiring every second year (individual term of 6 years)
It dissolves every 5 years along with the Assembly
Subject to annual re-election by local bodies
Fixed tenure of 6 years after which the entire council is dissolved
e: Article 172(2) ke anusaar vidhan parishad (Legislative Council) ek sthai (permanent) sadan hai jo kabhi bhi bhang (dissolve) nahi hoti - iske sadasyon ka karyakal 6 saal ka hota hai, aur har do saal mein ek-tihai (1/3) sadasya sevanivrit (retire) hote hain, isliye sadan kabhi khaali nahi hoti, keval navin (renew) hoti rehti hai. Iske vipreet vidhan sabha ka karyakal 5 saal ka hota hai aur use samay se pehle bhanga ja sakta hai. 'Purani sadasyata' wali baat aur 'annual re-election' wale vikalp galat hain; parishad ke sadasyon ki khaali jagah upchunav (by-election) se bhar jaati hai, par parishad khud nahi banti. Exam point: vidhan parishad = sthai sadan (dissolve nahi hoti), 6 saal ka karyakal, har 2 saal mein 1/3 sadasya retire (Article 172(2)).

qe: Under Article 174, who holds the constitutional authority to summon, prorogue, and dissolve the State Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 174 के तहत राज्य विधानसभा के सत्र को आहूत करने, सत्रावसान करने और भंग करने का अधिकार किसे है?
o: The President of India
The Governor of the State
The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
The Chief Minister
e: Article 174 ke anusaar rajya vidhan mandal (vidhan sabha ya dono sadanon) ki satr (session) bulana (summon), satr ko sthagit (prorogue) karna aur vidhan sabha ko bhang (dissolve) karna Rajyapal (Governor) ke adhikar mein hai - ye sab wo rajya ki mantri-parishad ki salah par karte hain. Rashtrapati sansad ke liye ye kaam karte hain, vidhan sabha ke Speaker keval sadan ke andar ki karyavahi chalate hain (sammon/bhangi nahi karte), aur mukhya mantri samvidhanik roop se ye shakti nahi rakhte (wo salah dete hain). Iske saath Article 174(1) ye bhi kehta hai ki lagatar do satr ka break 6 mahine se zyada nahi khinch sakta. Exam point: vidhan mandal ki satr sammon/prorogue aur vidhan sabha ki bhangi = Rajyapal (Article 174), mantri-parishad ki salah par.

qe: What proportion of members in a State Legislative Council are nominated directly by the Governor under Article 171?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171 के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद में कितने अनुपात में सदस्य राज्यपाल द्वारा सीधे मनोनीत किए जाते हैं?
o: One-twelfth (1/12th)
One-third (1/3rd)
Fixed at 12 members
One-sixth (1/6th) of the total members
e: Article 171(3)(e) ke anusaar vidhan parishad ke kul sadasyon ka ek-chhathvaan (1/6) hissa Rajyapal (Governor) dwara naamit (nominate) kiya jaata hai - aise sadasya aise logon mein se chune jaate hain jinhe saahitya, vigyan, kala, sahakari aandolan (cooperative movement) aur samaj-seva ke kshetra mein khaas gyaan ya anubhav ho. Iske alava 1/3 sadasya sthaniya sansthaon, 1/3 vidhan sabha ke sadasyon (MLAs) dwara, 1/12 graduate aur 1/12 adhyapak dwara chune jaate hain - yani naamit sadasya sabse bada alag (separate) hissa hote hain jo chunav se nahi aate. '1/12' graduate/teacher wale hisson ka hai, '1/3' MLA/local authorities ka, aur 'fixed 12' jaise parimarjanik (arbitrary) vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Rajyapal ke naamit sadasya = vidhan parishad ki kul sadasyata ka 1/6 (Article 171(3)(e)); Bihar mein lagbhag 12.

qe: If a deadlock arises between the Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council over an Ordinary Bill, how is it resolved under the Constitution?
qh: साधारण विधेयक पर विधानसभा और विधान परिषद के बीच गतिरोध उत्पन्न होने पर संविधान के तहत इसका समाधान कैसे किया जाता है?
o: The bill is permanently abandoned
The will of the Legislative Assembly prevails, as the Constitution does not provide for a joint sitting in State Legislatures
Through a joint sitting of both Houses presided by the Speaker
The Governor acts as arbitrator and passes binding orders
e: 'Deadlock' (gatirodh) hone par rajya vidhan mandal ke do sadanon ke beech aisi vyavastha nahi hai jaise sansad mein sanmilit baithak (joint sitting) hoti hai - samvidhan mein rajya vidhan mandalon ke liye joint sitting ka koi pravdhan nahi hai. Article 197 ke anusaar vidhan parishad agar kisi sadharan vidheyak ko do baar (pehli baar 3 mahine tak aur dobara 1 mahine tak) bina paas kiye rakhti hai, to vidheyak aise maan liya jaata hai jaise vidhan sabha ne use paas kar diya ho - yani antim roop se vidhan sabha ki ichha (will) hi bhaari hoti hai. Isliye vidheyak 'hamesha ke liye lap' nahi hota, aur Rajyapal ka koi arbitrate ka role nahi hai. Haan, dhan vidheyak par to vidhan parishad ki bhoomika 14 din tak hi hoti hai (Article 198). Exam point: rajya mein joint sitting nahi hoti; deadlock par Article 197 ke anusaar vidhan sabha ki raay bhaari (parishad 3 mahine + 1 mahine tak rok sakti hai).

qe: Who served as the first Speaker of the Bihar Legislative Assembly in 1937?
qh: 1937 में बिहार विधानसभा के पहले अध्यक्ष के रूप में किसने कार्य किया था?
o: Vindheshwari Prasad Varma
Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha
Ram Dayalu Singh
Deep Narayan Singh
e: 1937 mein Bihar vidhan sabha ke pehle Adhyaksh (Speaker) Ram Dayalu Singh the - unke kaaryakal mein Bihar pranty ki vidhan sabha ke kuchh mahatvapurn karyavahi hui; 'Bihar ke saanchit pita' ke roop mein jaane jaane wale Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha to 1937 se pehle Bihar-Orissa ki vidhan parishad ke adhyaksh rahe the aur 1921 ki central assembly ke bhi, isliye wo alag pad ke hain. Vindheshwari Prasad Varma aur Deep Narayan Singh Bihar ke rajnitik vyaktitva the, par vidhan sabha ke pehle Speaker ka pad Ram Dayalu Singh ko mila. Exam point: Bihar vidhan sabha (vidhan mandal) ke pehle Adhyaksh = Ram Dayalu Singh (1937); Sachchidananda Sinha parishad/central assembly ke adhyaksh rahe.

qe: Under Article 192, who decides questions regarding the disqualification of a sitting member of the State Legislature (other than on grounds of defection)?
qh: दलबदल के अलावा, राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी सदस्य की अयोग्यता के प्रश्नों पर अंतिम निर्णय कौन लेता है?
o: The Speaker or Chairman of the respective House
The State Law Minister
The Governor, acting according to the binding opinion of the Election Commission of India
The High Court having territorial jurisdiction
e: Article 192 ke anusaar vidhan mandal (vidhayak/MLA ya MLC) ke kisi sadasya ki nirhrit (disqualification) ke sawaal ka nirnay Rajyapal karte hain, aur wo bhi nirvaachan aayog (Election Commission) ki raay ke anusaar jo unke liye baandhne wali (binding) hoti hai - Rajyapal apni marzi se alag faisla nahi kar sakte. Ye vyavastha MP ke liye Article 102 wali vyavastha ke sahi-ant hai, jahan rashtrapati isi tarah nirvaachan aayog ki raay par nirnay lete hain. Haan, dal-badal (10vi anusuchi) wale mamlon mein faisla sadan ke adhyaksh (Speaker/Chairman) ka hota hai - ye alag pravdhan hai. Vidhik mantri ya High Court ko is mamle mein antim nirnay ka adhikar nahi hai. Exam point: MLA/MLC ki nirhrit (dal-badal ke alava) = Rajyapal, nirvaachan aayog ki binding raay ke aadhar par (Article 192).

qe: To whom does the Chairman of a State Legislative Council submit their written resignation under Article 183?
qh: अनुच्छेद 183 के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद का सभापति अपना त्यागपत्र किसे सौंपता है?
o: The Deputy Chairman of the Legislative Council
The Speaker of the Legislative Assembly
The Chief Minister
The Governor of the State
e: Article 183 ke anusaar vidhan parishad ka Adhyaksh (Chairman) apna istifa (resignation) vidhan parishad ke Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Chairman) ke paas rakhta hai - jaise vidhan sabha ke Speaker ka istifa vidhan sabha ke Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Speaker) ke paas jaata hai. Ye vyavastha sadan ki antarik (internal) karyapranali ka hissa hai, jismein istifa sadan ke doosre pravdhanik (presiding) padadhiish ke paas jaata hai; Rajyapal, mukhya mantri ya vidhan sabha ke Speaker ke paas nahi. Adhyaksh ke istifa ke baad jab tak naya adhyaksh na chuna jaaye, upadhyaksh sadan ki adhyakshta karte hain. Exam point: vidhan parishad ke Chairman ka istifa = Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Chairman) ke paas (Article 183); Speaker ka istifa = Deputy Speaker ke paas.

qe: What proportion of members of the Legislative Council are elected by the members of the Legislative Assembly (MLAs) under Article 171(3)(d)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(d) के तहत विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य विधानसभा सदस्यों (MLAs) द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-fourth (1/4th)
One-twelfth (1/12th)
One-sixth (1/6th)
One-third (1/3rd)
e: Article 171(3)(d) ke teht vidhan sabha ke sadasyon (MLAs) parishad ke ek-tihai (1/3) sadasya chunte hain - yani rajya ke vidhayak hi apne beech se aise logon ko parishad mein bhejte hain jinhe vidhayak ke roop mein chuna nahi gaya; isse parishad ko lok-tantra (representative) ka saamaanya adhaar milta hai. Iske alava 1/3 sthaniya sansthaon (nagar palika, zila parishad) dwara, 1/12 graduate, 1/12 adhyapak aur 1/6 Rajyapal dwara naamit hote hain. Isliye 1/3 ka jod MLA wala hissa hai; '1/12' aur '1/4' aankde is vishay ke nahi hain, '1/6' naamit sadasyaon ka hai. Exam point: vidhan parishad mein MLA dwara chune jaane wale sadasya = kul sadasyata ka 1/3 (Article 171(3)(d)).

qe: Under Article 171(3)(b), what proportion of members of a State Legislative Council are elected by the graduates constituency?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(b) के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य स्नातक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-sixth elected by university professors
One-third elected by registered degree holders
One-twelfth (1/12th) elected by persons who have been graduates for at least 3 years
One-fourth elected by state bar councils
e: Article 171(3)(b) ke teht parishad ka ek-barhvaan (1/12) hissa graduate nirvachak mandal se aata hai - is mandal mein wo vyakti vote dete hain jo kam se kam 3 saal se sneatak (graduate) hain aur rajya ke kisi bhi vishwavidyalaya ke chunav kshetra (graduates' constituency) mein panjikrit (registered) hain - yani ye 'sneatak nirvachak mandal' hote hain, jismein sirf degree dharak matdata vote karte hain. Isi tarah adhyapak (teachers) ka bhi 1/12 hissa hota hai. '1/3' MLA aur sthaniya sansthaon ka hissa hai, '1/4' ya 'professors wala 1/6' samvidhan mein nahi hai - isliye sahi aankda 1/12 (3 saal se graduate) hi hai. Exam point: vidhan parishad mein graduates dwara chune jaane wale = 1/12 (graduate hoke 3 saal pur hokar panjikrit ho); teachers wala hissa bhi 1/12.

qe: Under Article 171(3)(c), what proportion of members of a State Legislative Council are elected by the teachers constituency?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(c) के तहत राज्य विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य शिक्षक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-sixth (1/6th)
One-third (1/3rd)
Fixed quota of 10 teachers
One-twelfth (1/12th) elected by persons engaged in teaching for at least 3 years in secondary schools or higher
e: Article 171(3)(c) ke teht adhyapak nirvachak mandal (teachers' constituency) parishad ka ek-barhvaan (1/12) hissa chunta hai - is mandal mein wo adhyapak vote karte hain jo kam se kam 3 saal se madhyamik (secondary) ya uchch (higher) star ke vidyalayaon mein padha rahe hain - yani ye 'adhyapak nirvachak mandal' (teachers' constituency) hote hain, jismein keval adhyapak vote karte hain. Isliye '1/6', '1/3' ya '10 adhyapak' wale vikalp samvidhan ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate; '1/6' Rajyapal ke naamit sadasyaon ka hissa hai. Dhyan rahe - graduates aur adhyapak ka hissa dono 1/12 hain, aur yahi dono aise hisse hain jine 'nirvachak mandal' kaha jaata hai. Exam point: vidhan parishad mein adhyapak dwara chune jaane wale = 1/12 (kam se kam 3 saal se secondary ya higher star mein padhane wale).

qe: What is the minimum statutory membership floor fixed by Article 171 for any State Legislative Council?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171 द्वारा किसी भी राज्य विधान परिषद के लिए न्यूनतम सदस्य संख्या क्या निर्धारित है?
o: 30 members
40 members
50 members
60 members
e: Article 171 ke anusaar kisi bhi rajya ki vidhan parishad (Legislative Council) ka nyoontam (minimum) sadasyata 40 hoti hai - isse chhoti parishad banayi nahi ja sakti, chahe rajya ki abadi kitni bhi kam ho; adhiktam sankhya vidhan sabha ki kul sadasyata ka ek-tihai (1/3) hoti hai (aur vyavharik roop se apvaad bhi hain). Bihar ki vidhan parishad mein 75 sadasyon ki vyavastha hai, jo is seema ke aadhar par tay hai. Isliye '30', '50' ya '60' wale aankde galat hain; samvidhan mein 40 hi likha hai. Iska tark yahi hai ki parishad ka aakaar itna bada ho ki wo apni samiksha (review) ki bhoomika sahi tarah nibha sake. Exam point: vidhan parishad ka nyoontam sadasyata = 40 (Article 171); adhiktam vidhan sabha ka 1/3.

qe: Under Article 210, what constitutional provision governs the languages used for transacting business in State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 210 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडलों में कार्य संचालन की भाषा के संबंध में क्या प्रावधान है?
o: Strictly the official language or languages of the State, or Hindi, or English
Sanskrit or Hindi exclusively
Only the regional mother tongue of the Chief Minister
Exclusively English in all proceedings
e: Article 210 ke anusaar rajya ki vidhayika (vidhan sabha aur vidhan parishad) mein karyavahi ki bhaasha ke liye teen raste hain - rajya ki aadhikarik bhaasha ya bhaashayein (jo Article 345 ke teht tay hoti hain), Hindi, ya angrezi (English); shuru ke 15 saal ke baad angrezi ka prayog vidhayika dwara jaari rakhne ka faisla liya ja sakta hai. Isliye 'keval Sanskrit/Hindi', 'mukhya mantri ki matrubhasha' ya 'hamesha angrezi' wale vikalp galat hain, kyunki samvidhan rajya ko apni bhaasha ke saath-saath Hindi aur angrezi ka bhi adhikar deta hai. Sadan ke adhyaksh ki anumati se sadasya apni matrubhasha mein bhi bol sakta hai. Exam point: rajya vidhan mandal ki karyavahi ki bhaasha = rajya ki aadhikarik bhaasha, Hindi ya angrezi (Article 210); angrezi ka prayog vidhayika ki ichha par jaari rah sakta hai.

qe: What is the maximum total time an Ordinary Bill passed by the Legislative Assembly can be delayed by the Legislative Council across all stages?
qh: विधानसभा द्वारा पारित किसी साधारण विधेयक को विधान परिषद दोनों चरणों में मिलाकर अधिकतम कितने समय तक रोक सकती है?
o: Indefinitely
Maximum 6 months
Maximum 4 months (3 months in first instance + 1 month in second instance)
Maximum 3 months
e: Article 197 ke anusaar vidhan parishad kisi sadharan vidheyak (Ordinary Bill) ko adhiktam 4 mahine tak rok sakti hai - pehli baar sadan mein aane par 3 mahine tak rok sakti hai (uske baad vidhan sabha use dobara bhejti hai) aur dobara aane par 1 mahina tak; agar parishad is samay mein bhi koi faisla na kare, to vidheyak vidhan sabha dwara paas maana jaata hai. Isliye '3+1 = 4 mahine' ka jod hi samvidhan ke aankdon se mel khaata hai - '6 mahine', '3 mahine' ya 'anel mitra (indefinite)' wale vikalp galat hain. Dhyan rahe dhan vidheyak (Money Bill) par ye avadhi sirf 14 din hoti hai (Article 198). Exam point: sadharan vidheyak par vidhan parishad ki adhiktam deri = 4 mahine (3 mahine + 1 mahina, Article 197); Money Bill par 14 din.

qe: Article 212 of the Constitution explicitly places which restriction on the judiciary regarding State Legislatures?
qh: संविधान का अनुच्छेद 212 राज्य विधानमंडलों के संबंध में न्यायपालिका पर क्या रोक लगाता है?
o: Judges cannot contest state municipal elections
Courts cannot strike down state tax laws
High Court cannot issue writs against state ministers
The validity of any proceedings in the Legislature of a State shall not be called in question in any court on the ground of any alleged irregularity of procedure
e: Article 212 ke anusaar rajya vidhan mandal ki karyavahi (proceedings) ki vaidhata (validity) par kisi adalat mein is aadhar par sawaal nahi uthaya ja sakta ki usmein karyapranali (procedure) ki koi aniyamita (irregularity) thi - yani adalat vidhayika ke andar ki prakriya mein dakhal nahi de sakti. Haan, adalat us vidhi (law) ki vaidhata ki jaanch kar sakti hai jo vidhayika ne banayi ho (jaise mool adhikaron ka ullanghan), par karyavahi ki prakriya ko nahi. Isi tarah sansad ke liye Article 122 aur nagar palikaon/panchayaton ke liye alag pravdhan hain. Isliye 'tax laws rad nahi kar sakti' ya 'writ nahi de sakti' wale vikalp is pravdhan ka sahi arth nahi hain. Exam point: Article 212 = vidhan mandal ki karyavahi ko procedural aniyamita ke aadhar par court mein challenge nahi kiya ja sakta (vidhayika ki swatantrata).

qe: How did the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2020 affect the composition of the State Legislative Assemblies?
qh: 104वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2020 ने राज्य विधानसभाओं की संरचना को कैसे प्रभावित किया?
o: Abolished the Governor's power under Article 333 to nominate one Anglo-Indian member to the Legislative Assembly
Increased reservation for tribal areas
Mandated proportional representation in state cabinets
Lowered the assembly membership age to 21 years
e: 104th samvidhan sanshodhan, 2020 ne Article 333 ke teht Rajyapal ke us adhikar ko samapt kar diya tha jiske teht wo vidhan sabha mein Anglo-Indian samuday se ek sadasya ko naamit (nominate) karte the - yani ab kisi bhi rajya (Bihar samet) mein aisi nomination nahi hoti. Isi sanshodhan ne Lok Sabha mein Article 331 ke teht Anglo-Indian ke 2 naamit sadasyaon ki vyavastha bhi hata di, aur SC-ST ke liye aarakshan (reservation) ko 2030 tak badha diya. Isliye 'tribal area reservation badhi', 'cabinet mein proportional representation' ya 'aayu 21 saal' wale vikalp is sanshodhan se juda nahi hain. Dhyan rahe - aarakshan ki vyavastha (SC/ST) waise hi chalti rahi, sirf naamit sadasya wala hissa hata. Exam point: 104th sanshodhan (2020) = vidhan sabha mein Anglo-Indian ke naamit sadasya ki vyavastha khatm (Article 333); Lok Sabha mein bhi (Article 331).

qe: Under Article 171(3)(a), what proportion of members of a State Legislative Council are elected by local authorities (Municipalities, District Boards)?
qh: अनुच्छेद 171(3)(a) के तहत विधान परिषद के कितने सदस्य स्थानीय प्राधिकरणों (नगर पालिकाओं, जिला बोर्डों) द्वारा चुने जाते हैं?
o: One-fourth (1/4th)
One-third (1/3rd)
One-twelfth (1/12th)
One-sixth (1/6th)
e: Article 171(3)(a) ke teht sthaniya sansthaayein (local authorities - nagar palika, nagar nigam, zila parishad, panchayat samiti) parishad ke ek-tihai (1/3) sadasya chunti hain. Ye vyavastha isliye hai ki sthaniya (local) swaraj sansthaon ko bhi rajya ki upar wali sadan mein pratinidhitva mile aur unke mudde wahan uthaye ja sakein. Iske alava 1/3 MLA dwara, 1/12 graduates, 1/12 teachers aur 1/6 Rajyapal ke naamit hote hain - yani '1/3' sthaniya sansthaon aur MLA dono ka hissa hai, jabki '1/12' aur '1/6' alag vishayon ke hain. Isliye sahi jod 1/3 hai. Exam point: vidhan parishad mein sthaniya sansthaon dwara chune jaane wale = 1/3 (Article 171(3)(a)).

qe: Under Article 187, what structural provision is made for the secretarial staff of State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 187 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडल के सचिवालयीय कर्मचारियों के लिए क्या व्यवस्था की गई है?
o: Staff is borrowed directly from the central Lok Sabha secretariat
Secretariat is managed directly by the State Public Service Commission
The Governor personal staff handles all assembly files
Each House of the State Legislature shall have a separate secretarial staff independent of the executive government
e: Article 187 ke anusaar rajya vidhan mandal ke pratyek sadan (vidhan sabha aur vidhan parishad) ka apna alag sachivalaya-karmachari (secretarial staff) hota hai, jo karyapalika (executive) se swatantra rehta hai - iska matlab ye hai ki sadan apne karmachariyon ki bharti, niyukti aur sewa-shartein khud tay kar sakti hai. Yahi vyavastha sansad ke liye Article 98 mein hai. Ye svatantrata isliye zaroori hai ki vidhayika sarkar ke adheen hokar apni kaam-kaaj par nirnay lene mein kamzor na ho; sadan apne karmachariyon ka vetan-bhata bhi kanoon se tay karti hai. Kendra se staff udaar (borrow) karna, rajya lok seva aayog ko prabandh dena, ya Rajyapal ke staff ko jimmmedari dena - ye samvidhan ke pravdhan nahi hain. Exam point: Article 187 = rajya vidhan mandal ke pratyek sadan ka alag, swatantra sachivalaya karmachari (jaise sansad ke liye Article 98).

qe: Under Article 203(3), on whose recommendation alone can a 'Demand for Grant' be moved in the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 203(3) के तहत विधानसभा में 'अनुदान की मांग' किसकी सिफारिश पर ही पेश की जा सकती है?
o: The Leader of Opposition
The Chief Minister
The Speaker of the Assembly
The Governor of the State
e: Article 203(3) ke anusaar vidhan sabha mein 'anudhan ki maang' (Demand for Grant) keval Rajyapal ki sifarish (recommendation) par hi prastut ki ja sakti hai - yani budget ke kharchon ki maang Rajyapal ke naam se aati hai, aur koi bhi sadasya apni marzi se aisi maang nahi rakh sakta. Isi tarah dhan vidheyak (Money Bill) aur vittiye vidheyak ke liye bhi Rajyapal ki sifarish zaroori hoti hai (Article 207), taaki sarkar ki vittiye zimedari (financial responsibility) bani rahe. Mukhya mantri, vidhan sabha adhyaksh ya vipaksh ka neta apni marzi se aisi maang prastut nahi kar sakte; haan, sadasya (members) maang par sanshodhan ya katauti ke prastaav rakh sakte hain, par nayi maang nahi. Exam point: Demand for Grant keval Rajyapal ki sifarish par (Article 203(3)); Money Bill/vittiye vidheyak ke liye bhi Article 207 ke teht sifarish zaroori.

qe: Under Article 189(1), what is the nature of the voting power exercised by the Speaker of a State Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 189(1) के तहत विधानसभा अध्यक्ष द्वारा प्रयोग की जाने वाली मतदान शक्ति की प्रकृति क्या है?
o: The Speaker can cast a proxy vote on behalf of the Chief Minister
The Speaker votes in the first instance on all state bills
The Speaker has two votes on constitutional resolutions
The Speaker does not vote in the first instance, but exercises a casting vote only in the case of an equality of votes (tie)
e: Article 189(1) ke anusaar vidhan sabha ka Adhyaksh (Speaker) pehle (in the first instance) vote nahi deta - wo keval tabhi vote deta hai jab matdan (votes) barabar ho jaayein (equality of votes), taaki kisi ek paksh ko nirnayak laabh na mile; ise 'casting vote' kehte hain. Yahi vyavastha Rajya Sabha ke adhyaksh aur sansad ke Speaker ke liye bhi hai, aur isse adhyaksh ka tatasth (neutral) rahna darshaya jaata hai. 'Proxy vote', 'pehle instance mein sab vidheyakon par vote', ya 'do vote' - jaise vikalp samvidhan ke usool se nahi milte. Dhyan rahe - sadasya ke roop mein adhyaksh ka vote alag baat hai, par adhyaksh ke pad se wo keval tie todne ke liye vote deta hai. Exam point: Speaker ka vote = keval barabari (tie) hone par casting vote (Article 189(1)); pehle instance mein koi vote nahi.

qe: Under Article 180, who performs the duties of the office of Speaker when both the offices of Speaker and Deputy Speaker are vacant?
qh: अनुच्छेद 180 के तहत जब अध्यक्ष और उपाध्यक्ष दोनों के पद रिक्त हों, तब अध्यक्ष के कर्तव्यों का पालन कौन करता है?
o: The Chief Minister ex-officio
Such member of the Assembly as the Governor may appoint for the purpose
The senior-most member of the Legislative Council
The Secretary of the Legislative Assembly
e: Article 180 ke anusaar jab vidhan sabha ke Adhyaksh (Speaker) aur Upaadhyaksh (Deputy Speaker) dono ke pad khaali ho jaayein, to unke kartavya (duties) ek aise sadasya dwara nibhaye jaate hain jise Rajyapal is kaam ke liye niyukt (appoint) kare - yani Rajyapal sadan ke kisi sadasya ko adhyakshta ke liye naamit karte hain. Ye vyavastha tab tak chalti hai jab tak naye Speaker/Deputy Speaker ka chunav na ho jaaye. Mukhya mantri ex-officio adhyaksh nahi ban sakte, vidhan parishad ke sadasya (wo alag sadan hai) nahi bula sakte, aur sachiv (secretary) sirf prashasnik sahayog deta hai, adhyakshta nahi karta. Isi tarah Article 184 parishad ke Chairman/Deputy Chairman ke mamle mein hai. Exam point: Speaker aur Deputy Speaker dono ke pad khaali = Rajyapal dwara niyukt sadasya adhyakshta karta hai (Article 180).

qe: What core parliamentary immunities are conferred upon state legislators and the Advocate General under Article 194?
qh: अनुच्छेद 194 के तहत राज्य के विधायकों और महाधिवक्ता को क्या मुख्य संसदीय उन्मुक्तियां प्राप्त हैं?
o: Right to veto High Court judicial verdicts
Freedom of speech in the Legislature and immunity from court proceedings for anything said or any vote given in the House or its committees
Immunity from arrest in criminal homicide cases
Complete exemption from state motor vehicle regulations
e: Article 194 ke anusaar rajya vidhan mandal ke sadasyaon ko sansadiya visheshadhikar (privileges) milte hain - sabse ahem yahi ki sadan ke andar kahi gayi kisi bhi bat ya diye gaye kisi bhi vote ke liye kisi bhi adalat mein karyavahi nahi ki ja sakti, aur unhe abhivyakti ki poori swatantrata hoti hai; ye chhoot (immunity) mahadhivakta (Advocate General) ko bhi milti hai, jo sadan ki karyavahi mein bhaag lete hain. Lekin ye chhoot kisi criminal aapraadh (jaise hatya) se nahi bachati aur na hi sadan ke bahar ki baton par lagu hoti hai. Isliye 'High Court ke verdict par veto' ya 'hatya ke mamle mein bhi chhoot' wale vikalp galat hain; sahi arth 'bhaashn aur vote ke liye immunity' hi hai. Exam point: Article 194 = vidhayak aur Advocate General ko sadan ke andar bhaashn/vote ke liye court se chhoot + abhivyakti ki swatantrata.

qe: Under Article 204, how can money be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund of the State?
qh: अनुच्छेद 204 के तहत राज्य की संचित निधि से धन की निकासी कैसे की जा सकती है?
o: Through an executive sanction signed by the Chief Minister
Only pursuant to an Appropriation Act passed by the State Legislature
Through an ordinance without legislative ratification
By an order of the State Accountant General
e: Article 204 ke anusaar rajya ki sammilit nidhi (Consolidated Fund of the State) se koi bhi dhan tabhi nikala ja sakta hai jab vidhan mandal 'viniyog vidheyak' (Appropriation Bill) paas kar de - is vidheyak ke paas hone par sarkar ko kanooni (legal) shakti milti hai ki wo nidhi se paisa nikaal kar apne kharchon ko pura kare. Isliye mukhya mantri ka executive aadesh, adhyadesh (ordinance) ya Rajya Lekhaparikshak (Accountant General) ka aadesh paisa nikalne ka aadhar nahi banana chaahiye; Appropriation Act hi vidhik aadhar hai. Isi tarah kendra mein Article 114 (Appropriation Bill) ke teht kendra ki sammilit nidhi se paisa nikala jaata hai. Exam point: rajya ki Consolidated Fund se paisa nikalne ka aadhar = Appropriation Act (Article 204); bina vidhayika ki manzoori kharch nahi.

qe: Under Article 190(2), what is the rule regarding simultaneous membership in Parliament and a State Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 190(2) के तहत संसद और राज्य विधानमंडल की एक साथ दोहरी सदस्यता के संबंध में क्या नियम है?
o: The Governor decides which seat the member shall retain
A person can hold both seats indefinitely
The seat in Parliament becomes vacant automatically within 24 hours
If a person is elected to both, they must resign from the State Legislature within 14 days, failing which their State seat becomes vacant
e: Article 190(2) ke anusaar agar koi vyakti ek saath sansad (Lok Sabha/Rajya Sabha) aur rajya vidhan mandal dono ka sadasya chun liya jaata hai, to use dono mein se kisi ek se istifa (resign) dena padta hai - aur agar wo 14 din ke andar apni rajya vidhan mandal ki sadasyata se istifa nahi deta, to uski rajya vidhan mandal wali seat apne aap khaali (vacant) ho jaati hai. Isi niyam ke teht ek vyakti ek saath do sadanon ka sadasya nahi rah sakta; yahi vyavastha yaad rakhna ahem hai kyunki do bade padon ka ek saath hona samvidhanik vyavastha ke khilaf hai. Rajyapal ka faisla, 24 ghante wali baat ya 'dono seat hamesha' jaisi soch samvidhan ke pravdhanon se hat kar hai. Exam point: sansad + rajya vidhan mandal dono ke liye chuna gaya vyakti = 14 din ke andar rajya seat se istifa, warna rajya seat khaali (Article 190(2)).

qe: What is the maximum permissible time interval between two consecutive sessions of a State Legislature under Article 174?
qh: अनुच्छेद 174 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडल के दो सत्रों के बीच अधिकतम कितना अंतराल मान्य है?
o: 6 months
3 months
1 year
9 months
e: Article 174(1) ke anusaar rajya vidhan mandal ke do satron (sessions) ke beech 6 mahine se adhik ka antar nahi ho sakta - yani sarkar ko har 6 mahine mein vidhan mandal ki baithak bulani hi padti hai. Iska tark yahi hai ki vidhayika keval naam ke liye na rah jaaye aur sarkar par vidhayika ki nigrani bani rahe; isi tarah sansad ke liye Article 85(1) mein bhi 6 mahine ka hi niyam hai. 3 mahine, 9 mahine ya 1 saal wale vikalp samvidhan ke aankde se mel nahi khaate. Dhyan rahe - 6 mahine ka niyam 'baithak na hone' ke antar ke liye hai, vidhan sabha ke karyakal (5 saal) ke liye nahi. Exam point: do satron ke beech adhiktam antar = 6 mahine (Article 174(1)); sansad ke liye bhi yahi niyam (Article 85).

qe: When the State Legislative Assembly is dissolved, does the Speaker immediately vacate office?
qh: जब राज्य विधानसभा भंग होती है, तो क्या विधानसभा अध्यक्ष तुरंत पद छोड़ देता है?
o: The Speaker hands over charge to the Governor within 24 hours
Yes, the office falls vacant immediately upon dissolution
The Chief Minister assumes the administrative charge of the House
No, the Speaker shall not vacate their office until immediately before the first meeting of the new Assembly
e: Vidhan sabha ke bhang (dissolution) hone par Adhyaksh (Speaker) apna pad turant nahi chhodte - samvidhan ke pravdhan ke teht wo apne pad par 'nayi vidhan sabha ki pehli baithak se turant pehle' (immediately before the first meeting of the Assembly after dissolution) tak bane rehte hain. Iska tark yahi hai ki bhang sadan ka koi zaroori kaam, jaise naye sadasyaon ko shapath dilana ya sadan ki pehli baithak ki vyavastha, purane Speaker hi kar sakein, aur sadan ke record-kaam mein vyavadhan (interruption) na ho. Naye sadan ka chunav hone ke baad naya Speaker chuna jaata hai. 'Turant khaali ho jaana', '24 ghante mein Rajyapal ko saunpna' ya 'mukhya mantri ko prashasnik charge' wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: vidhan sabha bhang hone par Speaker tab tak rehta hai jab tak nayi sabha ki pehli baithak se pehle wo pad khatm na ho (Article 179 ka pravdhan).

qe: Under Article 200, when a Bill passed by the State Legislature is presented to the Governor, what constitutional courses of action are available?
qh: अनुच्छेद 200 के तहत जब कोई विधेयक राज्यपाल के समक्ष प्रस्तुत किया जाता है, तो उनके पास क्या विकल्प होते हैं?
o: Refer the bill directly to the Supreme Court for legal vetting
Only assent or reject within 14 days
Dissolve the legislative council automatically
Assent to the bill, withhold assent, return the bill (if not a Money Bill) for reconsideration, or reserve the bill for the consideration of the President
e: Article 200 ke anusaar jab rajya vidhan mandal dwara paas kiya hua vidheyak Rajyapal ke saamne aata hai, to unke paas chaar vikalp hote hain - (1) vidheyak par anumodan (assent) dena, (2) anumodan rokna (withhold), (3) agar vidheyak dhan vidheyak na ho to use sadan ko punarvichar (reconsideration) ke liye wapas bhejna, aur (4) vidheyak ko rashtrapati ke vichaar ke liye aarakshit (reserve) karna. Ye chaar vikalp hi samvidhan mein likhe hain; Supreme Court ko bhejna, 14 din ki seema ya vidhan parishad ko dissolve karna is pravdhan ka hissa nahi hai. Isliye sahi jod 'assent, withhold, return (gair-dhan vidheyak) ya reserve' hi hai - aur yad rahe ki punah paas hone par Rajyapal ko anumodan dena padta hai (Article 200 ka proviso). Exam point: Article 200 = Rajyapal ke chaar vikalp - anumodan, rok, punarvichar ke liye wapas (gair-dhan vidheyak), ya rashtrapati ke liye aarakshan.

qe: Under the Representation of the People Act, 1951, what is the mandatory timeframe for holding a by-election to fill a casual vacancy in the Legislature?
qh: लोक प्रतिनिधित्व अधिनियम 1951 के तहत विधानमंडल में आकस्मिक रिक्ति को भरने के लिए उपचुनाव कराने की समय-सीमा क्या है?
o: At the sole discretion of the State Cabinet
Within 6 months from the date of occurrence of the vacancy (unless the remainder of the term is less than 1 year)
Within 3 months
Within 1 year
e: Lok Pratinidhitva Adhiniyam (Representation of the People Act), 1951 ke anusaar vidhan mandal ki kisi sthaan ke khaali (casual vacancy) hone par upchunav (by-election) 6 mahine ke andar karana hota hai, lekin ek apvaad yahi hai ki agar avadhi (term) ka bacha hua samay 1 saal se kam ho to upchunav karana zaroori nahi hota. Isse samay, dhan aur prashasnik mehnat bachti hai jab chunav ka koi vajood nahi banta. '1 saal', '3 mahine' ya 'rajya mantri-parishad ki marzi' wale vikalp kanoon ke aankdon se mel nahi khaate - RPA, 1951 aur uske niyamon mein hi 6 mahine ki seema tay hai. Exam point: upchunav = 6 mahine ke andar (RPA 1951), par agar shesh avadhi 1 saal se kam ho to apvaad.

qe: In the Bihar Legislative Assembly (total 243 seats), what is the statutory reservation of seats for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST)?
qh: बिहार विधानसभा (कुल 243 सीटें) में अनुसूचित जातियों (SC) और अनुसूचित जनजातियों (ST) के लिए सीटों का आरक्षण क्या है?
o: 35 seats for SC and zero seats for ST
40 seats for SC and 5 seats for ST
38 seats reserved for SC and 2 seats reserved for ST
25 seats for SC and 10 seats for ST
e: Bihar vidhan sabha (243 nirvachan-yogya seat) mein anusuchit jaati (SC) ke liye 38 seat aur anusuchit janjati (ST) ke liye 2 seat aarakshit (reserved) hain - yani kuchh nirvachan kshetra (constituencies) keval SC ya ST pratyashiyon ke liye hain. Bihar mein ST ki abadi kam hone ke kaaran unki seat bhi kam hain, jabki SC ke liye zyada seat nirbar hui hain. Aise aarakshan ki vyavastha Delhi ke jaise aadhar (bade nirvachan kshetra) par hoti hai, aur iske baad bhi general (khuli) seat rahti hain. '35 SC + 0 ST', '40 SC + 5 ST' ya '25 SC + 10 ST' wale aankde sahi nahi hain - Election Commission ke aankdon ke anusaar 38 aur 2 hi sahi jod hai. Exam point: Bihar vidhan sabha (243) = 38 SC aarakshit + 2 ST aarakshit seat; baaki SC/ST ke liye aarakshan sansad ke kanoon/parimaajan (delimitation) ke aadhar par tay hota hai.

qe: Under Article 186, who determines the salaries and allowances of the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly?
qh: अनुच्छेद 186 के तहत विधानसभा अध्यक्ष और उपाध्यक्ष के वेतन और भत्तों का निर्धारण कौन करता है?
o: The Governor of the State through executive order
The State Legislature by Law
The State High Court Registrar
The Union Parliament
e: Article 186 ke teht Speaker aur Deputy Speaker ke vetan-bhatte (salaries and allowances) rajya vidhan mandal vidhi (Law) dwara tay karti hai - yani in pads ke laabh ke liye kanoon banane ka adhikar rajya vidhayika ke paas hai, na ki Rajyapal ke executive aadesh, High Court ke registrar ya kendra ke sansad ke paas. Isi tarah vidhan parishad ke Chairman/Deputy Chairman ke vetan ke liye Article 186 hi lagu hota hai (parishad ke adhyaksh ke mamle mein). Dhyan rahe - kanoon na banne tak kuchh vyavastha samvidhan/niyamon ke teht chalti hai, par vetan 'kanoon dwara tay' hi hota hai. Exam point: Speaker/Deputy Speaker ke vetan-bhatte = rajya vidhan mandal ka kanoon (Article 186).

qe: What is the total sanctioned membership strength of the Bihar Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad)?
qh: बिहार विधान परिषद की कुल स्वीकृत सदस्य संख्या कितनी है?
o: 81 members
60 members
95 members
75 members
e: Bihar vidhan parishad (Vidhan Parishad) mein kul 75 sadasyon ki vyavastha hai - jismein 24 sthaniya sansthaon dwara, 24 MLA dwara, 6 graduates, 6 teachers aur 12 Rajyapal dwara nomit sadasya hote hain (aur ek khaas vyavastha ke tahat kuchh anya padadhiish bhi hote hain). Ye 75 ki sankhya Article 171 ke 1/3 wali shed (vidhan sabha 243 ka 1/3 = 81 se kam) aur 40 wali nyoontam shed ke aadhar par banti hai. 60, 81 ya 95 wale aankde anya rajyaon ke parishadon ke ya galat gannaon ke hain, kyunki Bihar ke liye tay sankhya 75 hi hai. Exam point: Bihar vidhan parishad = 75 sadasya (1/3 sthaniya sansthan, 1/3 MLA, 1/12 graduate, 1/12 adhyapak, 1/6 Rajyapal ke naame).

qe: Under Article 172(1), who has the power to extend the 5-year duration of the State Legislative Assembly during a Proclamation of National Emergency?
qh: अनुच्छेद 172(1) के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान राज्य विधानसभा के 5 वर्ष के कार्यकाल को बढ़ाने की शक्ति किसके पास है?
o: Parliament by Law, for a period not exceeding one year at a time
The State Governor by proclamation
The Supreme Court of India
The Chief Minister with Cabinet approval
e: Article 172(1) ke anusaar vidhan sabha ka karyakaal (5 saal) samanya samay se badhaya nahi ja sakta, lekin rashtriya aapatkal (National Emergency) ke dauran samvidhan usse badhane ki chhoot deta hai - aur ye badhotri 'Parliament ke kanoon dwara' hoti hai, ek baar mein ek saal se adhik nahi, aur aapatkal samapt hone ke baad 6 mahine se aage nahi chal sakti. Isliye Rajyapal ke aadesh, Supreme Court ke kahe ya mukhya mantri ke cabinet ke samarthan se vidhan sabha ka karyakaal nahi badhta. Isi tarah sansad ke liye Article 83 ke teht Lok Sabha ka karyakaal bhi aapatkal mein sansad ke kanoon se ek saal tak badh saakta hai. Exam point: vidhan sabha ka karyakaal aapatkal mein badhana = Parliament ke kanoon se, ek baar mein 1 saal tak (6 mahine ke andar aapatkal khatm hone ke baad khatm).

qe: Under Article 177, what special procedural right is conferred upon Ministers and the Advocate General in bicameral State Legislatures?
qh: अनुच्छेद 177 के तहत मंत्रियों और महाधिवक्ता को द्विसदनीय राज्य विधानमंडलों में क्या विशेष प्रक्रियात्मक अधिकार प्राप्त है?
o: Power to dissolve either House unilaterally
The right to speak and take part in the proceedings of both Houses and any committee, but the right to vote only in the House of which they are a member (Advocate General cannot vote)
Immunity from all legislative motions
The right to vote in both Houses simultaneously
e: Article 177 ke anusaar do sadan wale rajya mein mukhya mantri aur anya mantri, tatha rajya ke mahadhivakta (Advocate General), dono sadanon (vidhan sabha aur vidhan parishad) ki karyavahi mein bhaag le sakte hain, aur sadan ki samiti (committees) mein bhi - par 'matdan' (vote) ka adhikar unhe keval usi sadan mein hota hai jiska wo sadasya hain; yani ek sadan ka mantri doosre sadan mein bol sakta hai par vote nahi de sakta, aur Advocate General (jo sadan ka sadasya nahi hota) kabhi vote nahi daal sakta. Yahi vyavastha sansad mein Article 88 ke teht hai. Isliye 'dono sadanon mein vote ek saath' ya immunity wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Article 177 = mantri/Advocate General dono sadanon mein bol sakte hain, par vote sirf usi sadan mein jiska wo sadasya hain; Advocate General ka vote nahi.

qe: Under Article 181, can the Speaker preside over the Assembly while a resolution for their own removal from office is under consideration?
qh: अनुच्छेद 181 के तहत, क्या अध्यक्ष तब विधानसभा की अध्यक्षता कर सकता है जब उसे पद से हटाने का प्रस्ताव विचाराधीन हो?
o: The Speaker is barred from entering the assembly hall
No, the Speaker shall not preside, though they have the right to speak and take part in the proceedings and vote in the first instance (but not in case of equality of votes)
Yes, the Speaker retains full presiding authority until the final vote is cast
The Governor automatically presides over the sitting
e: Article 181 ke teht hataye (removal) ka prastav chalne ke doran vidhan sabha ka Adhyaksh (Speaker) apne sadan ki adhyakshta nahi karega jab uske khilaf hataye (removal) ka prastav vichaaradheen (under consideration) ho - kyunki aisa mamla apne hi bhaavishya ke bare mein faisla hone wala hota hai. Is samay wo sadan ke sadasya ke roop mein bhaag le sakta hai, bhashan de sakta hai aur pehle instance (first instance) mein vote bhi de sakta hai, par barabari (tie) hone par casting vote nahi de sakta. Yahi niyam sansad ke Speaker ke liye Article 94/96 ke tahat lagu hota hai. Isliye 'hamesha adhyakshta karta hai', 'sadan mein aane se rok' ya 'Rajyapal khud adhyakshta karen' wale vikalp galat hain. Exam point: hataye ka prastav chalne par Speaker adhyakshta nahi karta; bol-vote kar sakta hai par barabari todne wala vote nahi (Article 181).

qe: If a member elected to a State Legislature is expelled from their political party, does it automatically trigger disqualification from the House under the Tenth Schedule?
qh: यदि राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी सदस्य को उसके राजनीतिक दल से निष्कासित कर दिया जाता है, तो क्या 10वीं अनुसूची के तहत वह स्वतः अयोग्य हो जाता है?
o: No, party expulsion does not amount to voluntarily giving up party membership; the member remains an unattached member in the House
Yes, if ratified by the Governor within 7 days
Yes, expulsion by party automatically vacates the legislative seat
Disqualification applies only if the member joins the ruling party
e: Dasvi anusuchi (anti-defection law) ke anusaar kisi sadasya ko uski partiy dwara nikaal (expel) diya jaana apne aap nirhrit (disqualification) nahi karata - kyunki nirhrit ke teen aadhar hain: swaichchhik roop se sadasyata chhodna, whip ke virudh vote karna/matdan se door rahna, aur swatantra sadasya ka party mein shaamil hona. Supreme Court ne bhi kaha hai ki party se nikaale jaane par sadasya vidhan mandal mein 'unattached' (kisi party se juda na hona) ki sthiti mein reh sakta hai; isliye expulsion aur sadasyata chhodna alag baat hain. Haan, agar nikaala gaya sadasya baad mein kisi anya party join karta hai to 10vi anusuchi ke teht nirhrit ho sakta hai. Isliye 'expulsion se khud-ba-khud seat khatm' wala vikalp galat hai. Exam point: party se expulsion = apne aap nirhrit nahi (Article 102/191 ke alava 10vi anusuchi ke aadhar alag hain); sadasya 'unattached' reh sakta hai.

qe: Under Article 329, what is the constitutional procedure for challenging the validity of any election to the State Legislature?
qh: अनुच्छेद 329 के तहत राज्य विधानमंडल के किसी चुनाव की वैधता को चुनौती देने की संवैधानिक प्रक्रिया क्या है?
o: Only by an Election Petition presented to the High Court as provided by the Representation of the People Act, 1951
Through an appeal before the State Human Rights Commission
Through a direct administrative petition to the Governor
By an inquiry conducted by the District Collector
e: Article 329 ke anusaar vidhan sabha/parishad ke chunav ko chunauti dene ka raasta sansad ke kanoon ke anusaar hi khulta hai - yani chunav se jude vivad keval 'nirvachan yachika' (Election Petition) ke roop mein High Court ke saamne laaye ja sakte hain, jaisa Lok Pratinidhitva Adhiniyam (RPA), 1951 mein tay hai; aur chunav ki prakriya (poll ke doran) ke mamlon mein adalat ka dakhal vidhi ke anusaar hi hota hai. Rajyapal ke paas administrative yachika, SHRC (State Human Rights Commission) ya District Collector ki jaanch is mamle ka raasta nahi hai. Ye vyavastha isliye hai ki chunav se jude vivad ek nirdharit nyayik prakriya se nipataye jayein, taaki rajniti mein asthirata na ho. Exam point: chunav ko chunauti = High Court mein election petition (Article 329 + RPA, 1951); koi rajya-Rajyapal/DC wali jaanch nahi.
